title: Instructions, Example SQL and Trusted Assets
brief: Instructions are the weakest way to shape an answer, so spend them carefully.
- Add 10 example queries. At least 3 parameterised, with typed, commented parameters.
- Register 2 Unity Catalog functions as trusted assets: one that settles the AUM
definition, one that settles the flow netting. 06_curated created four you can use.
- Write 4 text instruction blocks, including one clarification rule for 'return' —
which has three defensible readings, so the right behaviour is to ask.
- Submit an instruction budget: what you spent, against the 100 instruction ceiling.
Every example SQL query, every SQL function, and the whole General instructions block
each count as ONE instruction against that ceiling of 100.
NOTE ON GRADING. Counts are automatic. Whether a clarification rule is any good is not —

checks.name: 10 or more example queries
checks.hint: A worked example teaches Genie more per instruction than any paragraph.

checks.name: Instruction text is present
checks.hint: The whole General instructions block counts as one instruction, so write it once and well.

checks.name: Still inside the 100-instruction ceiling
checks.hint: Example queries plus SQL functions plus the instruction block must stay under 100.
